operative_clauses.original_operative_text:
R evocation  of E xecutive  Order No. 99081  
of  D ecember  5, 1947
WHEREAS Executive Order No. 9908  
of December 5, 1947 (12 P. R. 8223), en­
titled “Reservation of Source Material in  
Certain Lands Owned by the United  
States”, requires that a specific reserva­
tion to the United States of all source  
materials in whatever concentration, as  
defined in section 5 (b) (1) of the Atomic  
Energy Act of 1946 (60 Stat. 760; 42  
U. S. C. sec. 1805), shall be contained in  
all disposals, leases, permits, or other  
authorizations to use lands other than  
public lands theretofore or thereafter  
acquired by the United States or any in­
strumentality thereof, so far as not in  
conflict with law; and

it is ordered  
that the said Executive Order No. 9908 of  
December 5, 1947, be, and it is hereby,  
revoked.
The revocation of Executive Order No.  
9908 shall not be construed to affect the  
revocation of Executive Order No. 9701  
in the manner and to the extent provided  
in Executive Order No. 9908.
